Except as otherwise specified for the particular license type, applicants for a license shall be required to take an examination in accordance with the rules of the department.
(Am. L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)
Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2021/126.
